description: This file defines a React component called RoleCard used in a Next.js frontend project for exploring roles. It manages display logic, state for expanded/collapsed view, skill matching, and interaction points like setting a role as target, with styling for visual effects.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-array inputs and nullish or empty strings.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into properly punctuated sentences with bullets.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a number capped between 0 and 100.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID from a role object, trying multiple possible properties.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and de-duplicates skills from various persona schema paths.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes a skill string to lowercase trimmed form.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds matching skills between persona skills and required skills, ensuring no duplicates.
